training_bias.scope: Descriptive official-training bias only. Frozen median uses these training labels; these are in-sample diagnostics, not validation gains or parameter-selection evidence.

definitions.ratio: GT/raw before clipping, per-image median, as original scalar estimator; ratio below1 suggests an image-level overestimation tendency
definitions.signed_log_error: Image mean log(clipped_prediction/GT); positive means overprediction
definitions.aggregation: Equal image means within each nonempty GT bin; scene ratios are medians across images in the scene
definitions.warning: A ratio median below1 and a positive mean relative error measure different summaries; neither implies every pixel or scene is overpredicted

saved_test_distributions.explanation: Descriptive summaries of previously saved official scores. No GT read, rescoring, fitting, confidence interval or new adoption decision.
